cloud_sync.title: Cloud sync
cloud_sync.description: Sync your encrypted config across devices via Dropbox or Baidu Netdisk. Config is encrypted with your master password before upload. OAuth token exchange goes through a proxy server — no secrets stored in the app.
cloud_sync.waiting_hint: Please complete authorization in the browser. It will return automatically.
cloud_sync.cloud_path_hint: For Baidu Netdisk, actual path is /apps/termfast + this path. Leave empty for default.
cloud_sync.master_password_placeholder: Password used to encrypt config for sync
cloud_sync.forgot_password_desc:
The master password cannot be recovered — it is not stored on the server or locally, and is only used to encrypt/decrypt config.

If you forgot your master password, you can reset credential management and set a new one.

Note: After reset, all previously encrypted server passwords will be cleared and need to be re-added.
cloud_sync.download_success: Config downloaded and imported from cloud
cloud_sync.password_required_desc: You must set a master password before {{action}}, otherwise server passwords and config will be exposed! Please enter your master password in the field above.
cloud_sync.disconnect_desc:
After disconnecting, the locally stored OAuth token will be deleted and you will need to re-authorize to sync again.

The encrypted config file already uploaded to the cloud is unaffected and remains in your netdisk.

Are you sure you want to disconnect?
cloud_sync.password_required: Cloud sync needs your master password to encrypt/decrypt the config file. Please enter it below.
